Cardinal Peak and the North Fork Entiat approach lie in general National Forest land outside designated wilderness — north of the Lake Chelan-Sawtooth Wilderness boundary (which runs close by, near Emerald/Saska Peaks) and well south of the Glacier Peak Wilderness, which is across the Entiat/White River divide.
expect.closures: CLOSED RIGHT NOW: the Little Giant Fire closure, in effect through 31 October 2026 unless lifted sooner, closes the Entiat River Road (FR 5100), FR 5606, the North Fork Entiat River Trail #1437 and the Pyramid Mountain Trail #1433, which is this route's entire access. Separately, the Entiat River Road corridor (FR-51) sustained damage in the December 2025 storm event; as of spring 2026 a landslide near the upper end of the road (beyond the FR-5606 junction, near Cottonwood Campground/Entiat River Trailhead) required a high-clearance-only temporary bypass with trailers prohibited. That damage is past the FR-5606 turnoff used for Cardinal Peak, but check current Okanogan-Wenatchee NF alerts/current-conditions pages before driving.
